GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (27 Feb 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1549)
APO 500
27 February 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of a Suspected War Criminal.
The following named Japanese will be apprehended as a Suspected War Criminal and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date.
NAME RANK OR TITLE PERTINENT DATA
SATO, So Lt Col (51J-92658) CO, Mixed Force (SATO Force) at Tapel, Gonzaga, Luzon, P.I., Jul 1945; part of 80th Brig, 103 Div, under Maj Gen YUEUCHI Toshitaro. Repatriated from Manila on "TSUKUSHI MARU", 29 May 46 (Hospital Shipment "G"); arrived at Sasebo about 4 Jun 46, Line 1268.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
